name: fpr_opt_out
display_name: Opting out returns every held page
description: Escape-hatch contract: removing EnableFpr plus a device restart returns every held page

test_steps.guest_run: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters' -Name EnableFpr -Value 1 -Type DWord; Write-Output 'PASS: EnableFpr=1 set'

test_steps.desc: Restart balloon device and let the hold settle
Confirm pages are held before opting out
Opt out: remove EnableFpr (default off again)
test_steps.guest_run: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters' -Name EnableFpr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'PASS: EnableFpr removed'

test_steps.desc: Restart balloon device to renegotiate without the feature
Give the pages time to come back
Verify every held page was returned
